Signal a Coordinate Problem with a Classed Condition

Source: R/design_utils.R
dot-grid_stop.Rd

Carries two phrasings of the same problem: message, for someone calling a metric directly, and reason, a fragment summary() reports in place of a metric it cannot compute. Both are defined at the throw site so they cannot drift, and the class lets callers dispatch without matching on message text.

Usage

.grid_stop(class, reason, ...)

Arguments

class

Condition subclass naming the specific problem.

reason

Short phrase for a summary() field.

...

Pasted together to form the message.
